    Questions

    Why does Spotify cost less in some countries?+

    Spotify prices each market against local incomes and local competitors. In markets with cheaper local music apps it sets Premium low to win subscribers; in richer markets it charges more. It also relies on the free, ad-supported tier to bring in listeners who may upgrade later.

    Where is Spotify Premium cheapest in 2026?+

    Nigeria, at ₦1,600 a month ($1.18). The ranking uses the Premium Individual plan in every country so the comparison is like for like.

    Do cheaper countries get a worse Spotify?+

    No. Premium has the same features and sound quality in every country. The core catalogue is the same worldwide; a few tracks are limited by regional licensing, which has nothing to do with the price.

    Can I pay the price of another country?+

    Spotify charges the price of the country your account and payment method belong to. It usually requires a local payment method and asks you to re-confirm your country, so a cheaper country's price isn't available just by changing your location.

    What happens to my price when I travel or move?+

    Premium keeps working abroad at your home country's price. If you move, Spotify asks you to update your country, and from then on you pay the new country's price.

    Does Spotify Premium have regional pricing?+

    Yes. Premium Individual has 61 different prices across the 179 verified countries, in 44 currencies: from ≈ $1.18 a month in Nigeria to ≈ $19.07 in Denmark, a 16× gap. Some of these prices are before tax and others include it, so part of the difference is tax.

    Which country is cheapest for each Spotify Premium plan?+

    Premium Individual: Nigeria (≈ $1.18 a month); Premium Standard: India (≈ $1.47 a month); Premium Platinum: India (≈ $3.17 a month); Premium Student: Nigeria (≈ $0.59 a month); Premium Duo: Nigeria (≈ $1.55 a month); Premium Family: Nigeria (≈ $1.85 a month). Only verified prices count, and yearly prices are divided by twelve.

    Why do subscription prices differ by country?+

    Companies set a price for each market based on what people there earn, what local rivals charge, taxes and the local currency. The same plan can cost several times more in one country than in another.

    Why might I see a different price than the one here?+

    Taxes, an introductory offer, paying in the iPhone app instead of on the website, or a recent price change. Prices in US dollars also move a little with the exchange rate, updated every week.

    Where do these prices come from?+

    From each service's own website or its App Store listing, read as a visitor from that country sees it. We check every month, convert with the same exchange rate for every country (updated every week), and only rank prices we could confirm.
